studio_small_03_1k.hdr
======================

Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_03
Author: Sergej Majboroda
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
        https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

This HDR environment map is used as the default IBL for Three.js scenes
generated by Dreambyte. Loaded via RGBELoader → PMREMGenerator into
scene.environment for image-based lighting on PBR materials.

To replace, swap the .hdr file under public/vendor/hdri/ and update the
URL in setupEnvironment() in lib/sceneTemplate.ts.
